welcome_returning: Welcome back. From the menu below you can see your licences and bots,
renew them, or add new features.
welcome_new: This bot sells and manages a TeamTalk music player bot.
Your bot runs on our server, gets its own audio line, and connects to
your own TeamTalk server. Just pick a plan.
🎬 YouTube is included by default; every other service and feature
can be added one at a time.
help: Help
How buying works
1. Pick a ready-made plan, or use “Custom” to choose months, bots
and features yourself.
2. You get an invoice in USD and toman; pay by card transfer.
3. Send the receipt photo here. It is checked automatically first, then an
admin approves it.
4. Once approved we ask for your TeamTalk server details and the bot goes live.
What is an audio line?
Each bot gets its own virtual audio cable on our server so the music reaches
the bot's microphone. When a licence is deactivated, that line is closed.
Included by default
YouTube (search and links), playlists, the queue, playback modes, volume,
seeking, history, and all the management commands.
Features you can add
{features}
Your own Telegram bot
You can create a bot with @BotFather and give us its token; then you manage
your bots from inside your own bot.
Something wrong?
Use “Contact support” and the admin will answer you here.

receipt_same_file: this is the *same file* as an earlier receipt (identical image hash) — probably resent

receipt_manual_needed: the automatic check couldn't run; needs a manual look
receipt_failed_transaction: the receipt says the transaction **did not go through** (“{marker}”)

receipt_amount_missing: the invoice amount ({expected} toman) wasn't found on the receipt
receipt_card_full: the destination card number was found **in full**
receipt_card_last4: the last 4 digits of the destination card ({last4}) were found
receipt_card_missing: the destination card ({last4}) wasn't found on the receipt
receipt_cards_both: both source and destination cards are present ({count} card numbers)
receipt_structure_good: the text is shaped like a bank receipt ({count} keywords)
receipt_structure_none: no bank-receipt keywords appear in the text
receipt_bank_missing: no bank or payment app name appears in the text
receipt_reference_reused: reference number {reference} was already used for another order

receipt_year_stale: ⚠️ the receipt year ({year}) is far older than the order — an old receipt?
